title: Technique for single-step lymphocyte isolation from an endoscopic biopsy specimen for the diagnosis of gastrointestinal lymphoma
author: Iwamuro, Takahashi, et al.

steps.title: Autoclave bowl and strainer
steps.instruction: Autoclave the porcelain bowl with spout (Narumi Co., Aichi, Japan) and the wire mesh tea strainer (Sun Co., Niigata, Japan) (diameter 55 mm, height 40 mm) before use.

steps.title: Place biopsy in saline
steps.instruction: Using disposable biopsy forceps (EndoJaw™, FB-230K, Olympus, Tokyo, Japan), obtain a single endoscopic biopsy specimen and immediately transfer it into a 15 mL conical centrifuge tube containing 5 mL normal saline solution.

steps.title: Decant specimen into strainer
steps.instruction: Set the wire mesh strainer inside the autoclaved porcelain bowl; invert the conical tube to mix, then decant the saline‑containing specimen into the strainer, ensuring the tissue is released from the tube bottom.

steps.title: Crush tissue in saline
steps.instruction: While the tissue remains immersed in saline, crush the solid pieces by pressing with the rubber portion of a 10 mL injection‑syringe plunger; fibrous debris will stay on the mesh.

steps.title: Collect lymphocyte suspension
steps.instruction: Remove and discard the mesh strainer, then pour the saline that now contains the lymphocytes into a clean 15 mL conical centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Filter and spin cells
steps.instruction: Filter the suspension through a 100 µm pore mesh strainer (Partec CellTrics, Sysmex, Kobe, Japan); centrifuge the filtrate at 400 × g for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash cell pellet
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant, resuspend the pellet in phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS), and centrifuge again at 400 × g for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Incubate with antibodies
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed pellet in PBS, add monoclonal antibodies against CD45 (J33; Beckman Coulter), CD19 (J3‑119; Beckman Coulter), CD20 (B‑Ly1; Dako), CD10 (ALB1; Beckman Coulter), CD3 (UCHT1; Beckman Coulter), CD5 (BL1a; Beckman Coulter) and polyclonal F(ab’)₂ antibodies for κ and λ light chains (Dako) at the optimal concentrations recommended by the manufacturers; incubate 15 min in the dark at room temperature.

steps.title: Lyse red blood cells
steps.instruction: Add VersaLyse Lysing Solution (Beckman Coulter) to the stained cells, mix, and incubate for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Final wash and resuspend
steps.instruction: Dilute the lysed sample with PBS, centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at room temperature, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 500 µL PBS for acquisition.

steps.title: Acquire flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Analyze the immunostained cells on a Navios flow cytometer (Beckman Coulter) using Kaluza analysis software version 1.3 (Beckman Coulter).
